title: Earth Sciences, B.S. (College of Earth and Mineral Sciences)
notes: University Park. Built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's own 'Suggested Academic Plan' (University Park Campus table) and 'Program Requirements' course list, fetched and verified via raw HTML (not WebFetch's summary) with each semester's per-term credit subtotal checked against the page's own printed totals (14/14/17/16/14/16.5/16.5-17.5/15 = 123-124 total), same as 2026's structure. Two real, confirmed differences from CMPSC-2026.json's era: (1) PHYS 211 has a real alternate option, PHYS 211 OR PHYS 250, and PHYS 212 likewise OR PHYS 251 -- both alternates are real, cataloged courses (confirmed in catalogs/phys_catalog.json, PHYS 250/251 both 4cr with prereqs already satisfiable by this point in the sequence) and this alternate was still live in the 2023-24 edition before being dropped starting 2024-25 (confirmed via archive diff). (2) The 'Biology: Basic Concepts and Biodiversity' requirement was a single 4-credit BIOL 110, not the BIOL 114(3)+BIOL 115(1) split used starting the 2026-27 edition (confirmed via archive diff against 2025-26, which still used BIOL 110; the split first appears in 2026-27's own live page). Rebuilt the Second-through-Fourth-Year sequence (Semesters 3-8) to match this year's own real bulletin row placement rather than copying 2026.json's rearranged placement of Minor Course/Advanced EARTH elective/Supporting Course/GEN ED across those terms -- 2022-23's actual table places GEN ED and a Supporting Course in Second Year Fall (not Minor Course + Advanced elective as 2026 does), etc.; slot-type totals still reconcile exactly against the bulletin's own aggregate requirements (5 Intro GEOSC/EARTH elective slots = 15cr, 5 Advanced EARTH elective slots = 15cr, 6 Minor Course slots = 18cr, 8cr of Supporting Course, 24cr of generic GEN ED slots covering the 45cr General Education total minus the 21cr already embedded in GN/GQ/GWS-tagged major courses). Major-code course lists (Intro/Advanced elective match regexes) are byte-identical to 2026's own Course List table entries for this requirement across all 5 catalog years checked (2022 through 2026 live) -- GEOG 110/111 are listed on the bulletin itself (GEOG 110 still carried a real title, 'Climates of the World', in this edition) but neither exists in this app's scraped catalog (catalogs/geog_catalog.json has no GEOG 110 or 111 entry in any year, since the app's course catalog is a single current snapshot, not year-versioned) -- so they're excluded from the match regex here too, same as 2026.json's own documented convention, to stay consistent with what the engine can actually recognize. Same post-prereq-parser-fix repair as EARTHSCI-2026.json/BIOL-2022.json: CHEM 110's real prereq is MATH 22 (chains through MATH 21, MATH 4, MATH 3), none of which the bulletin's own suggested plan lists as separate courses (they're assumed already satisfied via placement/AP credit) -- added explicitly in Semester 1/2 to keep CHEM 110 (and 111/112/113) schedulable, identical fix and rationale as the current 2026 file. General Education itself used the pre-overhaul 6-credit-per-domain model in this edition (Foundations GQ/GWS, Knowledge Domains GA/GH/GS/GN at 6cr each, Integrative Studies 'Inter-Domain or Approved Linked Courses' 6cr) rather than 2023-24's revised 3cr-domain-plus-Exploration model -- purely a Gen-Ed-policy relabeling with no effect on this app's generic 'GEN ED' slot count or credit totals (still 45cr total, unenforced beyond the GHW/GWS-tagged slots already modeled), so no JSON structural change was needed for that difference.
